_note: Things known to be in motion. Checked on every run regardless of the cycle. 'expect' is text whose appearance or disappearance means a brief needs a decision.

items.when_gone: Final guidance published: re-read every quotation and figure taken from the draft.

items.when_gone: Guidance reissued: re-read quotations in 3.1 and 3.2.

items.when_gone: Guidance reissued: re-read 4.5 quotation and figure.

items.what: Regulator's name. Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 s.117 establishes the Information Commission; UK GDPR reads 'the Commission' from 30 September 2026; ico.org.uk is now titled 'Information Commission's Office' (seen 2 October 2026)
items.when_gone: The regulator has renamed itself: rename across every brief in the next version.
